en:
It would've been impossible for Gonta to
have thrown that shot from the A/V Room!

Because there was an <CLT=cltSTRONG>obstacle<CLT=cltNORMAL> between
Rantaro and Gonta!
Obstacle?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>moving bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>... When Rantaro was killed,
it should've been open.

Yup, that's our evidence. The bookcase
door was open when he was killed.

When we all stepped into the library, that
bookcase door was still wide open!

Shuichi merely asserted that just now...
I would like you to prove it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It's in this picture. Here, look.

Um...I don't think this picture
shows the bookcase in question...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It's in this picture. Here, look.

Um...I don't think this picture
shows the bookcase in question...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Calm down, Kaede...
I know there's a picture that proves it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Is this meant to be evidence? I haven't 
the slightest clue what your point is.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What proves that the bookcase was open
when Rantaro was killed?
It's in this picture. Here, look.

These <CLT=cltSTRONG>two pictures<CLT=cltNORMAL> were taken by the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>camera facing the moving bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

These photos were taken moments
before Rantaro was killed.

The bookcase door is <CLT=cltSTRONG>completely open<CLT=cltNORMAL> here,
and then it closes automatically.

So by the time we entered the library,
the door had already closed itself.

Before Rantaro was killed, the bookcase
door was open.

Even if Gonta did throw the shot, it
would've hit the bookcase instead!

I see... Well, that pretty much shuts
the book on that theory, then.

If that's true, then there's no
possibility that Gonta is the culprit.

Whaaaaat? Why are you making this so
complicated? Just be the culprit already!
S-Sorry!
I don't think you need to apologize.

Yeah, that's right!
A man shouldn't apologize so easily!

I should be the one to apologize.
I am sorry for accusing you, Gonta.

No, Gonta understand.
Cuz...we gotta find culprit.

Well said! For a degenerate male, you're
actually pretty reasonable!
Ugh, I hate this sentimental crap.

Why's that? It's nice when everyone
gets along like this.

Are you stupid or something? I can't
stand people having a good time!

Daddy is too evil to feel ashamed
for being evil.
We could learn a lot from him.

Don't mind me, I'm not actually taking
notes—I'm placing bets on race horses.

I-I'm jonesing for a leaf! I need a
raccoon tail to chase my dragon!

It's good that Gonta's in the clear, but 
don't break out the confetti just yet.

We're out of suspects now. On top of that, 
we still don't even know how Rantaro died.

So we only know what the weapon is? How are
we supposed to find the mastermind with that!?

We know the murder weapon is the shot
put ball. But where did the culprit get it?

I think it was from the warehouse.
I saw track and field equipment there.

Then anyone would have been able to obtain it.
We need more information.
What's wrong, Shuichi?
Hm? A-Ah, it's nothing...

Gyaaaaaaaah! 
How do we find this darn culprit now!?

Hey culprit! Quit hiding!
Just be a man and fess up already!

We don't even know if they're 
a guy or not, though, right?
Or if they're even human...
Are you referring to me?

D-Don't worry, you guys! We're one step
closer to the truth, so don't give up!

Try to remember what happened! We can 
find more clues left by the mastermind!
Clues? What kinda clues?

Like...if Rantaro was deceived by the
mastermind and went to the library...

Maybe somebody saw Rantaro having a
suspicious conversation with someone?

It would be a good idea to figure out who
knew about our trap.

Either way, anything you guys remember
might be able to help with the case!

Yes, yes. But...are you sure the
culprit is also the mastermind?
Huh? Yeah, I think so... Why?

Then what Atua just told me about how
the culprit entered the library is correct.
Huh? I didn't hear anything.

Ah, that's right. Only I can hear
the voice of Atua.

Then I will speak on Atua's behalf,
as His prophet.

If the culprit is the mastermind, they could've
entered the library while avoiding the cameras.
<CLT=cltMIND>What?
You serious!? There's a way to do that!?
Supah serious, bruddah.
Your Atua sounds like a shady weirdo!

<CLT=cltMIND>A way for the culprit to enter the library
without being caught by the cameras...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that really possible?

Atua says...I should continue explaining
on His behalf.

Nyahahaha! Only Atua knows
the truth behind this incident!
